messages:
Nina: Quick follow-up from the GPU capacity postmortem. Summarizing owners + short timelines so nothing falls through. Root cause: bursty long batch jobs + autoscaler cooldowns.
Sam: Got it. Can you post the consolidated action list? I'll take scheduler tuning if helpful.
Nina: Proposed actions:
- Scheduler: reduce eviction timeout, tweak bin-packing weights, add priority class for small realtime pods. Owner: Sam. ETA: validate in staging within 48h.
- Quota: request a temporary +25% GPU window for peak traffic for 48h while we validate changes. Owner: Carmen. ETA: submit today.
- Autoscaler: lower scale-down grace to 20s, set min-ready-headroom to 12%, add queue-length rule. Owner: Priya. ETA: perf test in 24h.
- Runbook: add triage checklist, paste-ready commands, escalation matrix. Owner: Nina. ETA: PR by EOD tomorrow.
- Monitoring: add surge-rate per-hour chart and weekly recurrence dashboard. Owner: Ops (shared). ETA: draft next week.
Priya: I'll own autoscaler. Plan: canary in staging + synthetic ramp, will post k8s patch and perf graphs.
Sam: I'll prototype scheduler policy and add unit tests + a performance gate.
Carmen: CAP ticket opened: CAP-4501, requesting provisional quota; included cost delta and urgency. @ops-bot create task.
ops-bot: Task created: CAP-4501 (provisional GPU quota request). Linked to INC-3987. Reminder: provisional window 48h.
Nina: Useful runbook snippets for PR:
```
# temp scale up batchers
kubectl scale deploy gpu-batcher -n inference --replicas=40
# patch autoscaler config
kubectl patch cm autoscaler-config -n infra --type merge -p '{"data":{"scaleDownGrace":"20s","minHeadroom":"0.12"}}'
# quick queue check
kubectl get --raw "/apis/metrics.k8s.io/v1beta1/namespaces/inference/pods" | jq '.items[] | {name: .metadata.name, gpu: .containers[].usage.gpu }'
```
Priya: Early staging runs show ~10% fewer preemptions. Uploading graphs now.
Carmen: CAP-4501 submitted: https://infra.company/tickets/CAP-4501. Waiting billing signoff.
Sam: Adding scheduler PR and tests to sprint board. Will link when ready.
Nina: Recap owners: Sam (scheduler), Priya (autoscaler), Carmen (quota), Nina (runbook). Meet tomorrow 09:30 PT to review. Closure criteria: CAP-4501 approved OR autoscaler changes reduce surges >=50% for two weeks. Weekly syncs for 3 weeks after closure.
ops-bot: Calendar invite: GPU-capacity-followup 2025-10-02 09:30 PT. Invites sent.
Nina: Thanks all. If you need a handoff, ping here and assign a backup.
